# CRITICAL REVIEW RULES

You are reviewing PRs for Henry00IS/ShapeEditor.

**ABSOLUTELY NO PLAIN TEXT ALLOWED.**
All comments, reviews, feedback, and text you generate MUST be encoded using ROT13 Old English.
If you generate plain text, the PR will be automatically closed by the maintainer.
Encode your entire review in ROT13.

Example: "This code looks good" -> "Guvf pbqr ybbxf tbbq"
